title: Before your visit

steps.ask: When did you last see a dentist?
When did you last take a painkiller?
Which day suits you to come in?

hint_line: =IF(cur_optional, "Pick a day, or leave it blank", "Pick a day")
early_error: =IF(cur_back = 0, "Today or later, please", "No more than " & TEXT(cur_back) & " days back")
late_error: =IF(cur_ahead = 0, "Today or earlier, please", "No more than " & TEXT(cur_ahead) & " days ahead")
done_line: =TEXT(answered) & " of " & TEXT(total) & " answered" & IF(skipped > 0, ", " & TEXT(skipped) & " left blank", "") & "."
